This is the analysis file from October 2023 that produced the published cohort and Table 1 [@hemmige2024density]. It is kept for comparison: the [differences page](differences.qmd) lists each place where the replication departs from it, and why.

The file is unchanged except that file locations on the analyst's computer are replaced by `<data folder>/`. It is shown as text and is never run.
